values.note: 'Campsites may be reserved anytime online, by phone, or at the campground office.' Two nights minimum on Friday+Saturday, one night allowed Sunday-Thursday; the booking site sold one-night weeknight stays (Oct 2026, Apr, May, Jun and Aug 2027) and refused a one-night Friday. Primitive sites are first-come, first-served.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/holly-river-state-park/lodging/camping-at-holly-river-state-park/ ('Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday and Saturday) or for one night Sunday through Thursday.'; 'There is a 14-night maximum stay.') + https://wvstateparks.com/parks/holly-river-state-park/lodging/ ('Primitive sites are also available on a first-come-first-serve basis, for $24.99 a night.') + book.wvstateparks.com supplier 11067533 (one night 2026-10-27, 2027-04-20, 2027-05-11, 2027-06-15, 2027-08-10: 35-85 sites; one night 2027-06-18 Fri: none; 2027-06-18/20: 80), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booking site, Oct 2026 to Aug 2027, weeknights and weekends alike: electric sites $41.99 a night, 20 of them (e.g. 6-10, 13, 15, 25, 26) $46.99; Site 2, the one full-hookup site, $59.99. First-come primitive sites $24.99.

fees.source: book.wvstateparks.com supplier 11067533 'Holly River State Park Electric Campsites' ($41.99 / $46.99) and 8233687 ('Site 2, FHU, Year-round' $59.99), stays 2026-10-27 to 2027-08-12, read 2026-10-21 + https://wvstateparks.com/parks/holly-river-state-park/lodging/ (primitive $24.99)

values.note: Every reservable unit has electric (amperage not stated); one site (Site 2) is full hookup and sold year-round.

hookups.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/holly-river-state-park/lodging/camping-at-holly-river-state-park/ ('88 units with electric hookups') + book.wvstateparks.com supplier 8233687 ('Site 2, FHU, Year-round'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 88 units; 86 sold online (85 electric, two of them equestrian-only, plus full-hookup Site 2). One tent or trailer per site.

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/holly-river-state-park/lodging/camping-at-holly-river-state-park/ ('Holly River State Park's campground has 88 units'; 'Only one tent or trailer is allowed per site.') + booking site units, read 2026-10-21

values.note: Three dumping stations, four centralized bathhouses, two coin-operated washers and dryers.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/holly-river-state-park/lodging/camping-at-holly-river-state-park/ ('Three dumping stations and four centralized bathhouses are available as well as two coin-operated washers and dryers.'; 'electric hookups, picnic tables, Wi-fi'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Open spring through fall, weather permitting' (no dates); the one full-hookup site is sold year-round.

note: Campground in a narrow valley along the Left Fork of Holly River with some sites along the creek. --Claude
summary: Park page + booking site: confirmed the inherited online/phone booking, 2-night weekend minimum and 14-night max into the entry (one-night weeknights do sell online); fees $41.99-46.99 electric, high now $59.99 for the lone full-hookup site; 88 units, dump/laundry/Wi-Fi; spring-fall season (undated); primitive sites FCFS.
